text:
maria: Heads up — the new JS SDK sample app is spiking with 429s when paginating embeddings. Happens during onboarding stress tests.
devon: repro'd. Looks like the client tries to fire 8 parallel page requests and we hit tenant quota bursts.
ryan: is this the token-bucket we added last quarter? I thought it was per-client.
maria: it's present but configured with a high burst. Also retries are immediate (no jitter) so insta-replay. Sample app does `Promise.all(pages.map(fetchPage))` which amplifies it.
devon: exact snippet: ```js
await Promise.all(ids.map(id => client.embeddings.create(...)))
```
devon: simple fix in sample: sequentialize with p-limit 3 or use SDK's limiter. But JS SDK limiter currently isn't exported for sample apps to consume.
ryan: ah — SDK parity issue. Python has a public Throttle class (`redwood.sdk.Throttle`) but JS kept it internal to runtime.
sam: this is causing onboarding friction — new users hit quotas and blame Redwood. Can we patch sample app and add a quick note in docs? :grimacing: 
maria: also observed auth refresh race: when token refresh starts while N requests in flight, some requests get 401 then retries double-submit tokens. We should serialize refresh or add singleflight.
devon: +1 for singleflight. I can PR a small `auth.refreshLock()` wrapper that queues inflight refreshes.
ryan: For throttling let's do: export a `createThrottler({rate, burst})`, update sample to use `p-limit` fallback and doc snippet. Also add jittered backoff to retries: `backoff = base * (1 + Math.random())`.
sam: can we also add a checkbox in quickstart: "If you see 429s, lower concurrency or use throttler" so support can point to it.
ci-bot: deploy preview available at https://deployments.redwood-inference.dev/pr/462 — includes sample app throttle change.
maria: thanks devon/ryan — assigning to @devon for PR and @ryan for docs. I'll draft the support KB blurb.
devon: will open PR within the hour, linking the auth singleflight patch.
ryan: I'll prepare the docs patch and add example config: ```json
{ "throttle": { "rate": 50, "burst": 3 } }
```
maria: perfect. follow-up: let's add a tiny benchmark script to show tokens/sec vs concurrency so customers tune easily.
sam: love that. saves us 1:1 triage calls. :thumbsup:
